name: omnisense/omnidns
description: Omnidns: a domain name where it is registered, under any PHP host - whether it is free and at what price, registering and renewing it, the account's domains and their terms, their name servers, and the records of their zones; from OVH, Gandi, Cloudflare or Scaleway through one set of models. Providers are packages of their own (omnidns/ovh, omnidns/gandi, omnidns/cloudflare, omnidns/scaleway); no framework in require.

suggest.omnidns/ovh: OVHcloud: availability and price, registration and renewal, domains, name servers, zone records (over the official ovh/ovh client)
suggest.omnidns/gandi: Gandi: availability and price, registration and renewal, domains, name servers, LiveDNS records (API v5, a personal access token)
suggest.omnidns/cloudflare: Cloudflare: zone records (over cloudflare/sdk), the Registrar's domains and their terms
suggest.omnidns/scaleway: Scaleway Domains and DNS: availability, registration and renewal, domains, name servers, zone records
suggest.symfony/http-client: An HTTP client for the providers that take one (any symfony/http-client-contracts implementation does)
